title: Weather and Language
author: Juniper Almeida
blurb: Vesper Oyelaran, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must return to the place where the story went wrong before the house sale closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
